name: Servant
description: A Philadelphia couple are in mourning after an unspeakable tragedy creates a rift in their marriage and opens the door for a mysterious force to enter their home.

videos.title: Reborn
videos.overview: Leanne, a young nanny, is hired to care for baby Jericho. But all is not as it seems.

videos.title: Wood
videos.overview: As Leanne settles in, Sean worries that Dorothy and Jericho are not in good hands.

videos.title: Eel
videos.overview: Sean enlists Dorothy's brother, Julian, to monitor her relationship with Leanne.

videos.title: Bear
videos.overview: Leanne disobeys an order and discovers why Sean is so protective of baby Jericho.

videos.title: Cricket
videos.overview: With Dorothy and Sean gone for the day, Leanne makes a new friend.

videos.title: Rain
videos.overview: Leanne's strange uncle arrives unexpectedly. Dorothy fights to keep her nanny.

videos.title: Haggis
videos.overview: Dorothy throws a tense dinner party. Sean entrusts Leanne to help keep a secret.

videos.title: Boba
videos.overview: Julian is forced to relive a dark memory during a night of babysitting.

videos.title: Jericho
videos.overview: Leanne acts out at Dorothy after learning the truth about baby Jericho.

videos.title: Balloon
videos.overview: After Jericho's baptism, uninvited guests force difficult decisions. Season finale.

videos.title: Doll
videos.overview: Jericho and Leanne are missing. Dorothy devises a 72-hour game plan, while Sean and Julian continue hiding the truth.

videos.title: Spaceman
videos.overview: With Natalie's help, Sean and Julian uncover disturbing details about the cult. Dorothy sacrifices her career reputation for her family.

videos.title: Pizza
videos.overview: The Turners open up a family business as a front for a more important mission.
With a new guest in the house, Dorothy resorts to bold tactics to get what she wants.

videos.title: Cake
videos.overview: The Turners scramble to prepare for a pivotal meeting. Leanne bakes a mysterious cake.

videos.title: Espresso
videos.overview: An unexpected visitor pushes everyone to their limits as Sean re-examines his past and Dorothy attempts to negotiate a delicate exchange.

videos.title: Marino
videos.overview: The Marino family tragedy raises more questions about Leanne. Uncle George's presence in the house creates a problem for the Turners.

videos.title: Loveshack
videos.overview: Dorothy and Sean get a hopeful sign. Leanne and Julian get to know each other better.

videos.title: Goose
videos.overview: As they wait for Jericho's return, Dorothy and Sean pretend everything is fine at a tense Christmas Eve lunch.

videos.title: Josephine
videos.overview: An unexpected arrival threatens to tear Dorothy and Sean apart, leaving Leanne defenseless.

videos.title: Donkey
videos.overview: Three months after the attack, the Turners head down the shore. Left alone, Leanne has a more exciting day than she anticipated.

videos.title: Hive
videos.overview: Dorothy hosts a mommy-and-me group, but Leanne finds that she can't trust strangers.

videos.title: Hair
videos.overview: Julian digs for the truth about Jericho. New visitors at the local park worry Leanne.

videos.title: Ring
videos.overview: Leanne continues to be upset by other people. Bad luck strikes the Turner brownstone.

videos.title: Tiger
videos.overview: The Turners attend a block party on Spruce Street. Leanne finally feels comfortable outside of the house, but she finds herself in danger.

videos.title: Fish
videos.overview: Sean's dinner party goes south when Leanne is rude to a guest. Dorothy uncovers frightening details from the block party.

videos.title: Camp
videos.overview: Dorothy works with Veera to get Leanne out of the house, but Jericho and Leanne are more connected than they know.

videos.title: Donut
videos.overview: Isabelle threatens to uncover Dorothy's past.

videos.title: Commitment
videos.overview: Dorothy and Frank hatch a plan to get Leanne out of the Turner household for good.

videos.title: Mama
videos.overview: Dorothy makes a desperate final plan.

videos.title: Pigeon
videos.overview: The war between Leanne and the Church of the Lesser Saints reaches its peak.

videos.title: Itch
videos.overview: Leanne begins to torment Dorothy as chaos overtakes Spruce Street.

videos.title: Séance
videos.overview: Dorothy hires two live-in nurses to help speed up her recovery—and protect her from Leanne.

videos.title: Boo
videos.overview: Sean sees Leanne's true colors while she hunts her enemies on Halloween.

videos.title: Neighbors
videos.overview: Sean and Dorothy host the new neighbors on Spruce with plans to finally get Leanne out of the house.

videos.title: Zoo
videos.overview: The birthday party from hell ensues when the cult makes its boldest move yet with Leanne.

videos.title: Myth
videos.overview: Dorothy discovers a connection with Leanne. Uncle George shares information with the Turners.

videos.title: Tunnels
videos.overview: Sean and Julian make a decision about Leanne.

videos.title: Awake
videos.overview: Sean and Julian open up about a secret.

videos.title: Fallen
videos.overview: As the world crumbles, can anyone stop Leanne?

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 4 wins & 12 nominations total
